title: OpenVPN Secure Access
story: Students configure a secure VPN connection between clients and the protected network using OpenVPN.

tasks.title: Configure OpenVPN
tasks.description: Create or review the OpenVPN server configuration.
tasks.hint: Check server.conf for port, proto, dev, and certificate paths.

tasks.title: Generate Certificates
tasks.description: Generate the required CA, server, and client certificate material.
tasks.hint: Use Easy-RSA or existing OpenVPN certificate tooling.

tasks.title: Connect Client
tasks.description: Connect a client to the VPN using the generated profile.
tasks.hint: Start the client with the .ovpn profile.

tasks.title: Verify tun0 Interface
tasks.description: Confirm that the VPN tunnel interface exists on the client.
tasks.hint: Use ip addr or ifconfig to look for tun0.

tasks.title: Test Encrypted Communication
tasks.description: Verify traffic can cross the VPN tunnel securely.
tasks.hint: Ping or curl an internal VPN address.
